name: wp-utm-key-case-insensitive
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Query keys are lowercased by sanitizeKey(), so mixed-case UTM keys still create a touch. The TS engine reads keys case-sensitively via URLSearchParams and would see no signal.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT: plugin accepts any key casing (sanitizeKey lowercases, clicutcl-attribution.js:86-90,427-447); engine requires exact lowercase param names.
